bio: Housed in Landgasthof Karner, this cosy eatery makes for a lovely down-to-earth alternative to the adjacent fine dining restaurant. The outstanding chef, Hannes Fussel, proves that he is also a master of home-style cooking, turning seemingly simple dishes into a delight for the palate! Think lamb lights, Wiener schnitzel or the classic Tafelspitz (prime boiled beef) – diners are bowled over by the depth of flavour and presentation. Regional ingredients take centre stage, and the decor complements this perfectly: rustic charm and subtle modern elements make for a harmonious whole....
